title: Change a value through a pointer
explanation:
A pointer stores an address. The & operator gets an address.
Use * on the pointer to access the value at that address.

questions.prompt: Which line sets count to 8 through p?
questions.hint: Use the operator that accesses the pointed-to value, then replace it.

options.feedback: *p accesses count. Assigning 8 sets its value.
This adds 8 directly to count, giving 12.

questions.prompt: Which line makes p point to count?
questions.hint: A pointer needs an address. Which operator gives the address of a variable?

options.feedback:
This stores the value 4 as an address,
not the address of count.

p does not point anywhere yet,
so *p cannot be used.
